description:
Browser input errors are labeled, and keep the model's guidance visible. The conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} is served as a replay (its live stream is cut off) of 24 browser tool calls: 17 the backend rejected as invalid (listed below), 2 with actions this UI has no card for ("brand_new_action", which worked, and "other_new_action", which failed), one valid eval of "document.title", and one each of emulate_help, network_help, accessibility_help and profile_help. "The invalid cards" are the ".tool" elements whose text contains "Invalid browser call:" (has_text); the Nth invalid call below renders the Nth invalid card (pick it with nth, as the spec's invalidCards.nth(i) did). "The card for action A" is the ".tool" element that has a ".tool-command" whose text contains "browser (A)" (a "has" filter).
The invalid calls, in order, with the label each card's ".tool-command" shows, a text its expanded details contain, and for some the code its input shows (JSON-quoted here; the page shows the unquoted text):
1. ID missing-action: label "Invalid browser call: missing action · model asked to retry"; text "invalid browser call: \"action\" is required and must be a non-empty string. Choose an action from the browser schema and resend the call."
2. ID empty-action: label "Invalid browser call: missing action · model asked to retry"; text "invalid browser call: \"action\" is required."
3. ID legacy-missing: label "Invalid browser call: missing action"; text "unknown action: \"\""
4. ID string-input: label "Invalid browser call: input must be a JSON object · model asked to retry"; text "invalid browser call: arguments were sent as a quoted JSON string. Decoded arguments: {\"action\":\"eval\"}. Resend an unquoted JSON object with a non-empty string \"action\" and field types matching the browser schema."; code "{\"action\":\"eval\"}"
5. ID malformed-input: label "Invalid browser call: input must be a JSON object · model asked to retry"; text "invalid browser call: arguments were not valid JSON."; code "{\"action\":\"eval\""
6. ID null-input: label "Invalid browser call: input must be a JSON object · model asked to retry"; text "invalid browser call: arguments were null."
7. ID array-input: label "Invalid browser call: input must be a JSON object · model asked to retry"; text "invalid browser call: arguments were a JSON array."
8. ID number-action: label "Invalid browser call: action must be a string · model asked to retry"; text "invalid browser call: \"action\" must be a string, got 42."
9. ID null-action: label "Invalid browser call: action must be a string · model asked to retry"; text "invalid browser call: \"action\" must be a string, got null."
10. ID click: label "Invalid browser call: unsupported action \"click\" · model asked to retry"; text "invalid browser call: unknown action \"click\". Choose an action from the browser schema and resend the call. All supported actions: navigate, eval, screenshot."
11. ID emulate_bogus: label "Invalid browser call: unsupported action \"emulate_bogus\" · model asked to retry"; text "invalid browser call: unknown action \"emulate_bogus\". Choose an action from the browser schema and resend the call. All supported actions: navigate, eval, screenshot."
12. ID network_bogus: label "Invalid browser call: unsupported action \"network_bogus\" · model asked to retry"; text "invalid browser call: unknown action \"network_bogus\". Choose an action from the browser schema and resend the call. All supported actions: navigate, eval, screenshot."
13. ID accessibility_bogus: label "Invalid browser call: unsupported action \"accessibility_bogus\" · model asked to retry"; text "invalid browser call: unknown action \"accessibility_bogus\". Choose an action from the browser schema and resend the call. All supported actions: navigate, eval, screenshot."
14. ID profile_bogus: label "Invalid browser call: unsupported action \"profile_bogus\" · model asked to retry"; text "invalid browser call: unknown action \"profile_bogus\". Choose an action from the browser schema and resend the call. All supported actions: navigate, eval, screenshot."
15. ID width-type: label "Invalid browser call: wrong field type for resize · model asked to retry"; text "invalid browser call: field \"width\" must be an integer, got a JSON string."
16. ID await-type: label "Invalid browser call: wrong field type for eval · model asked to retry"; text "invalid browser call: field \"await\" must be a boolean, got a JSON string."
17. ID legacy-unknown: label "Invalid browser call: unsupported action \"legacy_bogus\""; text "unknown action: \"legacy_bogus\""
Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. There are exactly 24 [data-testid="tool-call-completed"] elements (one per call).
2. Mount every card: dispatch a "beforeprint" Event on window (an eval without expect), and wait (allow 15s) until there is no ".tool-card-mount-placeholder" element (count 0).
3. There are exactly 17 invalid cards, and no ".generic-tool-warning" inside any of them (assert_count of ".tool:has(.generic-tool-warning)" with has_text "Invalid browser call:" is 0).
4. For each invalid call above, in order, on its invalid card: its ".tool-command" text is exactly the label (assert_text); click its ".tool-header"; its ".tool-details" text then contains "Output (Error):" and contains the text; and if a code is listed, its first ".tool-code" element's text is exactly the code (assert_text).
5. The calls with no card of their own keep the bug-report warning: the card for action brand_new_action and the card for action other_new_action each have exactly 1 ".generic-tool-warning" inside, and the page has exactly 2 ".generic-tool-warning" elements.
6. The valid eval's card, the ".tool" element that has a ".tool-command" whose text contains "document.title", has a ".tool-emoji" whose text is exactly "⚡".
7. Each browser family keeps its own card: for each of "📱", "📡", "🌳" and "📊", exactly 1 ".tool-emoji" element's text contains it (assert_count with has_text).
